content_metadata.description: An educational video demonstrating how to check the Specific Absorption Rate (SAR) values of mobile phones and the importance of understanding these values for health reasons.

qAndA.question: What is the code used to check the SAR value on a mobile phone?
What is the SAR value of the black ZTE N90 mobile phone?

qAndA.answer: High SAR values can be harmful to the body, potentially causing cancer and other diseases.
qAndA.question: Why is it important to check the SAR value of a mobile phone?

qAndA.answer: The recommended safe limit for SAR values is 1.6 W/Kg.
qAndA.question: What is the recommended safe limit for SAR values?

qAndA.answer: The white mobile phone, the Carbon 18+, does not display a SAR value, suggesting that its SAR value might be higher than the recommended limit, indicating a potential health risk.
qAndA.question: Why is the white mobile phone not displaying a SAR value when the code is dialed?

scenes.contextualRelevance: The video educates viewers on the importance of checking SAR values to ensure phone safety.

narrativeProgression.description: The teacher explains the dangers of high SAR levels on mobile phones.
Two mobile phones are introduced: Carbon 18+ and ZTE N90.
The teacher shows how to check the SAR value of the ZTE N90 using the code *#07#.
The ZTE N90's SAR value is displayed as 0.905 W/Kg, which is deemed safe.
The teacher attempts to check the SAR value of the Carbon 18+ using the same code.
No SAR value is displayed for the Carbon 18+, implying a higher than the recommended level.
The teacher re-enters the code on the ZTE N90 to confirm its SAR value.
The video ends with the safe SAR value of the ZTE N90 displayed again.

youtube_description:
Radiation level of mobile should be less than 1.6 Watt/Kg. If you have the mobile whose radiation level is more than this limit, it is very harmful for your health. It will increase the chance to cancer to your body. So by testing it whether you have SAR (specific adoption rate ) is more or less than the limit, you can find. 

Here, we come for your help. Just dial *#07# on your mobile. If message shows the radiation level less than 1.6 W/Kg, then it is good. If it more than this limit or does not show, never buy such mobile.
youtube_title: How to Find Radiation Level of Mobile
